title: Manager Park Jin-man repeatedly emphasizes one name, "Thanks to Jurado"... Park: "I am even more grateful now. He delivered a valuable victory to Samsung."

 🌐 한국어 · 日本語 · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · العربية · Français · বাংলা · Русский · Deutsch Kang Hye-kyung Reporter 입력 2026.11.07 09:00 The Samsung Lions defeated the kt wiz to take Game 3 of the Korean Series, led by a strong pitching performance from Ariel Jurado, who allowed one run over seven innings. Samsung manager Park Jin-man repeatedly expressed his gratitude, noting that Jurado's dedication was a major boost to the team's bullpen management and victory.
 [Manager Park Jin-man encouraging the players](Photo: The 2026 KBO postseason Korean Series Game 3 between the kt wiz and the Samsung Lions held at Daegu Samsung Lions Park on the 6th. Samsung manager Park Jin-man is encouraging his players after winning the game. Photo courtesy of Yonhap) Leading Samsung to victory with 1 run over 7 innings
 The Samsung Lions defeated the kt wiz 5-1 in Game 3 of the 2026 KBO Korean Series held at Daegu Samsung Lions Park on the 6th. With this win, Samsung took a 2-1 lead in the series, moving one step closer to the championship. At the center of the victory was starting pitcher Ariel Jurado. Jurado allowed one run and struck out six batters over seven innings. Although kt scored the first run, Samsung overturned the game by scoring three runs in the second inning and secured the win with a solo home run by Park Seung-gyu in the eighth inning.
 Manager Park Jin-man: "Thanks to Jurado"
 After the game, manager Park Jin-man mentioned Jurado's name several times and gave him credit. Park assessed that they were able to win because Jurado lasted until the seventh inning in his third postseason appearance. Jurado was hit in the hand by a batted ball in the sixth inning but expressed his intention to keep pitching, and he ultimately held the mound through the seventh. Park said that he had initially expected Jurado to finish around the sixth inning considering his pitch count, but that Jurado kept giving his best effort, which had a positive impact on the whole team by not requiring many bullpen pitchers. Jurado also started in Games 2 and 5 against the KIA Tigers in the playoffs and became the winning pitcher in both games. He is leading Samsung's autumn baseball by continuing to pitch seven innings for three consecutive games in the Korean Series.
 Samsung to challenge for 3rd win in Game 4 on the 7th
 Manager Park Jin-man said he is even more grateful for Jurado's dedication than last year. Recalling the scene when Jurado took off his hat to greet the crowd after throwing a complete game shutout against kt in July of last year, he emphasized that pitching seven innings for three consecutive postseason games is even more incredible. He also expressed his desire to reward Jurado after the season ends. Samsung will start rookie Jang Chan-hee in Game 4, which will be held at the same venue on the 7th. Park explained that if Jang Chan-hee cannot pitch deep into the game, he plans to mobilize the entire bullpen. Since Won Tae-in is scheduled to start Game 5, he decided to determine the closer by watching the opposing lineup and the game situation. Park stated that although Samsung is ahead by one game, he will not be careless and will maintain the current momentum.
